text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The summer training camp season arrived once again this year.
This time, it would be the final push, especially
leading up to the Tenno Sho (Autumn) and the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
So when I handed this session's
training menu over to Biwa Hayahide...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Impressive, Trainer-kun.
You analyzed the Tenno Sho (Autumn) to this extent?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Plus the data for the Arima Kinen. Furthermore,
it even includes Brian's projected time for the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Just how much time have you spent on me?
It must have been quite an ordeal, right?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Then I shall gratefully accept.
In order to solidify my formula for victory.
